work.description: The act orders prayers and alms for famine-stricken Ireland. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF1469-1473 reads: Datum Romae apud Sanctam Mariam Majorem die XXV Martii Anno MDCCCXLVII. Pontificatus Nostri Anno Primo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
